item.title: MLOps Infrastructure & Pipelines
item.description:
Overview

Building the engineering infrastructure required to make ML research actually run in the real world. From data pipelines and experiment tracking to deployment and monitoring — the unglamorous but essential work that turns prototypes into production systems.

Stack & Architecture

Pipeline Framework

  • Kedro for structured ML pipelines with versioned dataCatalog
  • Apache Airflow for workflow orchestration and scheduling
  • Satellite data ingestion from Copernicus Hub and Google Earth Engine

Experiment Tracking

  • MLflow for experiment management, metric logging, and model registry
  • Custom dashboards for visualizing training curves and model comparisons
  • Integration with harvester GPS data alignment pipeline

Deployment

  • GitLab CI/CD for automated training jobs and model promotion
  • Docker containers for reproducible execution environments
  • Dash dashboards for operational yield monitoring with farming partners

Cloud

  • AWS Sagemaker for distributed training jobs
  • Azure Databricks for data processing at scale
  • Hybrid deployment supporting on-premise farm data integration

Key Deliverables

  • Satellite + weather + soil data ingestion pipeline (daily updates)
  • Automated model retraining triggered by new data availability
  • Field-scale yield monitoring dashboard for farming partners
  • Reproducible research environment via Docker + Kedro
